state_contract: Conditional state transitions; late callbacks cannot reopen terminal jobs. Completed requires local saved-response publication verification. Explicit archived retry recovery retains original authorization. All collected-review rechecks propagate config; config-mismatch failures may resume local routing after original task/evidence/current-version/no-transport checks, preserving old rows in config-routing-recovery.json. auto_action is not rework permission for pure ambiguity; grounded major defects or fully checked offline equation blockers are required. correction_result is stored separately from existing scientific assessment. Active preparing jobs remain owned by this producer until their futures end. sync may reconcile only an already prepared unsent source-rework intent with the exact legacy producer-interruption error, complete original task/report/archive/current-version/pause/human guards and atomic row/file-version checks; previous error is retained in an event and no rework/retry is created.
import_side_effects: No new service/browser/model starts; capabilities preserve their original explicit call side effects
compatibility: New projects use canonical packages and public APIs; existing resident entries are served only by pipeline adapters

card_correction_queue__allows_web_job.description: Requires host catalog_path; checks persisted correction/paper/review/source/old-card binding and ready/submitted state. Fail closed for absent identity. Explicit recovery=True checks needs_user identity and pause permission only; caller must validate authorized failure/archive evidence before recovery, never use it to send.

card_correction_queue__enqueue_review.description: Produce a correction request; the verifier never applies the request here.

card_correction_queue___collected_review.description: Recheck all original inputs, the complete reply and its unique formal URL.

card_correction_queue__enqueue_quotes.description: Only exact unique quote locations from the locally verified source text.

card_correction_queue__sync.description: Observe original source-rework progress and reconcile an existing unsent prepared intent only after the exact prior interruption error and full original evidence checks; never creates a rework, retry or model send.

recover_review_corrections__run_once.description: Within the original producer, validate collected formatting failures; queue grounded source-only successors or retire proven obsolete suggestions. No browser actions, fabricated changes or pause override.

side_effects: 修正队列、独立候选、新版卡片及再核验记录。
selection_and_retention: 修正输入必须绑定原文、旧卡片与报告指纹。人工决定、未知提交和暂停优先；修正完成后重新核验，直接通过不替代完整修正链。建议路由尝试成功或失败均从结束时刻起保持原60秒间隔。
runtime_activation: No automatic start/resume; existing controls and sole owner remain authoritative

recent_recovery_contract.versioned_rework: Formal publications/<id>/card.json accepted only with matching provenance, original packet/input/response/prompt and old correction binding

priority_contract: card_correction.priority_passed_first pins source-matched complete passing review corrections and their pending successor reviews before article-score/FIFO order; immutable original report remains the priority origin.
manual_seed_priority_contract: Registered manual root seeds rank first in every runnable stage, including preparation, cross-lane admission, correction successors, retry/recovery scans. Stable original FIFO/score within groups; no preemption, deadline bypass, pause override, extra retry or unknown resend. core.api.workflow_priority__seed_first preserves original recovery record objects.
